questions.q: Filing a false declaration in an electoral roll form (such as Form 7) is punishable under:
questions.explanation: **Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950**. Roll authorities: CEO, DEO, ERO and AERO.
questions.fact_text: Under the **Representation of the People Act**, the authorities for electoral rolls are the **CEO, DEO, ERO and AERO**. Filing a false declaration (e.g. in Form 7) is punishable under **Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950**.

questions.q: Census 2027 online self-enumeration for most of India begins on:
questions.explanation: **10 Jan 2027**; door-to-door 25 Jan-28 Feb 2027. Poll-bound States start earlier (16 Nov 2026).
questions.fact_text: Census 2027 Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) notified: **online self-enumeration from 10 Jan 2027**, door-to-door **25 Jan-28 Feb 2027**. In poll-bound **U.P., Goa, Uttarakhand and Punjab**: self-enumeration from 16 Nov 2026 and door-to-door **1 Dec 2026-5 Jan 2027**. Snow-bound areas (Ladakh, parts of J&K, H.P., Uttarakhand) finished by 30 Sept.

questions.q: World Bank (Oct 2026): India's extreme poverty ($3.00/day) fell between 2011 and 2023 from 27.1% to:
questions.explanation: Extreme poverty fell to **2.6%**; the $4.20/day line fell from 57.7% to 16.1%.
questions.fact_text: **World Bank** Poverty and Equity Brief (Oct 2026): between 2011 and 2023 the share below the lower-middle-income line (**$4.20/day**) fell from **57.7% to 16.1%**, lifting **496 million** people; extreme poverty (**$3.00/day**) fell from **27.1% to 2.6%**.

questions.q: According to the World Bank brief, a belt from U.P. to West Bengal holds what share of India's poor?
questions.explanation: **57%** of India's poor live in that belt.
questions.fact_text: World Bank: multidimensional poverty (OPHI MPI) fell from **53.8% (2005-06) to 16.4% (2019-21)**; the top 10% earn about **13 times** the bottom 10%; a belt from **U.P. to West Bengal** holds **57%** of India's poor; employment rose by about **134 million** in 2017-23, but youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9%.

questions.q: Which State was the first to implement a Uniform Civil Code (27 Jan 2025)?
questions.explanation: **Uttarakhand**. Goa's common civil code dates from Portuguese rule. UCC is in **Article 44**.
questions.fact_text: **Article 44** (Directive Principle) asks the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code. **Uttarakhand** became the first State to implement a UCC on **27 Jan 2025**; **Goa** has had a common civil code since Portuguese rule.

questions.q: Somnath temple, regarded as the first of the 12 Jyotirlingas, is in which district of Gujarat?
questions.explanation: At Prabhas Patan, **Gir Somnath** district; rebuilt on Sardar Patel's initiative and inaugurated in **1951**.
questions.fact_text: **Somnath** temple (Prabhas Patan, **Gir Somnath** district, Gujarat) is regarded as the first of the **12 Jyotirlingas**; it was rebuilt after Independence on Sardar Patel's initiative and inaugurated in **1951**.

questions.q: India launched Operation Sindoor in response to the Pahalgam attack on:
questions.explanation: The Pahalgam attack was on 22 April 2025; **Operation Sindoor** began on **7 May 2025**.
questions.fact_text: The **Pahalgam attack** (22 April 2025, Baisaran meadow) killed 26 civilians; India responded with **Operation Sindoor** on 7 May 2025 and many Pakistani nationals were sent back via **Attari-Wagah**.

questions.q: The four Labour Codes, in force from 21 Nov 2025, replaced how many central labour laws?
questions.explanation: They replaced **29** central labour laws.
questions.fact_text: The **four Labour Codes** (Wages 2019; Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions 2020) came into force on **21 Nov 2025**, replacing 29 central labour laws.

questions.q: The McMahon Line, the India-China boundary in the eastern sector, came from the:
questions.explanation: **Simla Convention, 1914**. The LAC is about 3,488 km long.
questions.fact_text: The **McMahon Line** (Simla Convention, **1914**) marks the India-China boundary in the eastern sector; the **LAC** is about **3,488 km** long.

questions.q: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) was set up in:
questions.explanation: **2012**, under the Civil Aviation Ministry, separate from the regulator DGCA.
questions.fact_text: The **Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB)**, under the Civil Aviation Ministry, investigates air accidents; it was set up in **2012**, separate from the regulator DGCA.

questions.q: The government approved selling a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to:
questions.explanation: **Fairfax Financial Holdings**, for about ₹53,000 crore.
questions.fact_text: The government approved selling a **60.72%** stake in **IDBI Bank** to Canada's **Fairfax Financial Holdings** for about **₹53,000 crore**; Rahul Gandhi opposed it, citing a 2003 promise to keep 50%. FM Sitharaman said the NDA revived the bank with ₹25,000+ crore recapitalisation.

questions.q: Chola bronzes were cast by which method?
questions.explanation: The **lost-wax** method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is linked with **Chidambaram**.
questions.fact_text: Chola bronzes were cast by the **lost-wax (cire perdue)** method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is associated with **Chidambaram**.

questions.q: The NVS-03 navigation satellite was launched on 30 Oct 2026 aboard:
questions.explanation: **GSLV-F18**, from Sriharikota, to restore **NavIC**.
questions.fact_text: **GSLV-F18** launched **NVS-03** (2,250 kg, 12-year life) from Sriharikota on 30 Oct to restore **NavIC**; it carries an **indigenous atomic clock** and adds an **L1** signal to L5/S. NavIC covers India and about **1,500 km** beyond.

questions.q: NavIC is planned as a constellation of how many satellites?
questions.explanation: **7** (3 geostationary + 4 geosynchronous); NVS-01 flew on GSLV-F12 in May 2023.
questions.fact_text: NavIC (earlier **IRNSS**) is planned as a 7-satellite constellation (3 geostationary + 4 geosynchronous); **NVS-01** was launched on **GSLV-F12** in May 2023.

questions.q: Who won the 2026 Candidates to challenge D. Gukesh for the world chess title?
questions.explanation: **Javokhir Sindarov** (Uzbekistan); the match is in Geneva in November.
questions.fact_text: **Javokhir Sindarov** (Uzbekistan) won the **Candidates** and will challenge **D. Gukesh** for the World Chess Championship in **Geneva** in November.

questions.q: D. Gukesh became world champion in December 2024 by beating:
questions.explanation: He beat **Ding Liren** in Singapore, at 18 the youngest undisputed champion.
questions.fact_text: **D. Gukesh** became the youngest undisputed world champion at **18** by beating **Ding Liren** in Singapore in **Dec 2024**. World's youngest GM ever: **Abhimanyu Mishra** (USA).

questions.q: Who became the first Indian to take 150 T20I wickets?
questions.explanation: **Arshdeep Singh**, in 103 matches.
questions.fact_text: **Arshdeep Singh** became the **first Indian to take 150 T20I wickets** (in 103 matches).

questions.q: India played its first women's Test on 31 Oct 1976 against:
questions.explanation: Against **West Indies** at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru.
questions.fact_text: **31 Oct 1976**: India played its **first women's Test**, against West Indies at the **M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru**; leg-spinner **Shubhangi Kulkarni** took 5/48. India's first women's Test win came in the fourth Test at **Patna**. India has played only 42 more women's Tests since.

questions.q: Manisha Bhanwala won gold at the 2026 World Wrestling Championships (Astana) in which category?
questions.explanation: **59 kg** — the first Indian woman to become world champion.
questions.fact_text: **Manisha Bhanwala** (Haryana) won **59kg gold** at the **World Wrestling Championships** in **Astana**, beating USA's Abigail Nette 8-6 — the **first Indian woman** to win a world title and India's second world champion after **Sushil Kumar** (66kg, Moscow 2010).

questions.q: Who became men's tennis world No. 1 for the first time in November 2026?
questions.explanation: **Alexander Zverev** (Germany), replacing Jannik Sinner.
questions.fact_text: **Alexander Zverev** (Germany, 29) will become **world No. 1** for the first time, replacing **Jannik Sinner** — the 30th different men's No. 1 and the oldest first-timer since **John Newcombe (1974)**. ATP rankings began in **1973**.

questions.q: Which city hosts the 2026 Youth Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: **Dakar, Senegal** (31 Oct-13 Nov) — the first Olympic event held in Africa.
questions.fact_text: **Senegal** hosts the **Youth Olympic Games** in **Dakar** (31 Oct-13 Nov 2026).

questions.q: The main Amrit Snan of Haridwar Kumbh 2027 (Mesh Sankranti) falls on:
questions.explanation: **14 April 2027**. The Kumbh runs 14 Jan-20 Apr 2027.
questions.fact_text: **Haridwar Kumbh 2027** runs **14 Jan-20 Apr 2027**; Amrit Snan dates include **6 Mar (Mahashivratri)**, **8 Mar** and **14 Apr (Mesh Sankranti, main Amrit Snan)**. Nearest airport: **Jolly Grant (Dehradun)**. Uttarakhand CM: **Pushkar Singh Dhami**.

questions.q: UNESCO listed the Kumbh Mela as Intangible Cultural Heritage in:
questions.explanation: **2017**. It is held at Haridwar, Prayagraj, Nashik and Ujjain.
questions.fact_text: Kumbh Mela is held at four places — **Haridwar** (Ganga), **Prayagraj** (Sangam), **Nashik** (Godavari) and **Ujjain** (Shipra). UNESCO listed it as **Intangible Cultural Heritage** in **2017**.

questions.q: Army Day (15 January) marks the day in 1949 when who took over as the first Indian Commander-in-Chief?
questions.explanation: Gen. **K.M. Cariappa**.
questions.fact_text: **Army Day** is observed on **15 Jan**, when Gen. **K.M. Cariappa** took over as the first Indian Commander-in-Chief in **1949**; since 2023 the parade has been held outside Delhi (Bengaluru 2023, Lucknow 2024, Pune 2025).

questions.q: The first Youth Olympic Games were held in 2010 at:
questions.explanation: **Singapore** hosted the first YOG in 2010.
questions.fact_text: Dakar 2026 is the first Olympic event of any kind held in **Africa**; the Youth Olympic Games began in **2010** (Singapore).

questions.q: NITI Aayog (Jan 2024) estimated how many people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23?
questions.explanation: About **24.82 crore** people.
questions.fact_text: NITI Aayog's national MPI paper (Jan 2024) said about **24.82 crore** people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23. The World Bank's extreme poverty line was revised to **$3.00/day** (2021 PPP) in 2025.

questions.q: Labour is a subject in which list of the Seventh Schedule?
questions.explanation: **Concurrent List**, so the Centre and States share it.
questions.fact_text: The editorial says the boards are too centralised: labour is in the **Concurrent List**; unorganised and gig workers are over **92%** of the workforce; the government claims social security coverage rose from **19% (2015) to 64.3% (2025)**. The **NCEUS** (chaired by **Arjun Sengupta**) had made recommendations two decades ago.

questions.q: 'Prisons' fall under:
questions.explanation: **Entry 4 of the State List**; the Centre circulated a Model Prisons Act, 2023.
questions.fact_text: **Prisons** are a **State List** subject (Entry 4). The Centre circulated a **Model Prisons Act, 2023**; NCRB's Prison Statistics 2022 put national prison occupancy at about **131%**.

questions.q: Under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019, the UT's Council of Ministers cannot exceed:
questions.explanation: **10%** of the 90-member Assembly, so nine at most.
questions.fact_text: Under the **J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019**, the UT's Council of Ministers cannot exceed **10%** of the 90-member Assembly, so nine is the maximum.

questions.q: The ICJ's July 2024 advisory opinion held which of these unlawful?
questions.explanation: It held **Israel's occupation** unlawful and asked it to end as soon as possible.
questions.fact_text: The **ICJ's July 2024 advisory opinion** held Israel's occupation of Palestinian territory unlawful and asked it to end as soon as possible; Justice Muralidhar urged states to comply.
